provenance.method: Accept all pre-existing revisions in each input, compare original to revised with Microsoft Word 16.112 (Review > Compare, new-document target) and Aspose.Words 25.10 (Document.compare with default CompareOptions), then inspect word/document.xml. Count field characters with XPath count(.//w:del//w:fldChar) and count formatting changes with count(.//w:rPrChange). This file is not regenerated by the minimal-pair refresh command.
provenance.countScope: Field-character counts are all w:fldChar descendants below w:del in each complete comparison output. Counts differ because the implementations choose different revision granularity; agreement means both place complete deleted-field scaffolding inside deletion, not that their document-wide counts are equal.
